# @jpisgeek/subscription-metadata

Persists explicit operator-supplied plan name, billing cadence, recurring price,
currency, renewal window, seats, and provider-declared limits. It keeps
subscription facts separate from API metering and never derives remaining quota
or per-token cost.

**Version** `2026.08.25.2` · **License** MIT · **Source**
https://github.com/jpisgeek/slog-bog/tree/main/subscription-metadata

## Install

```
swamp extension pull @jpisgeek/subscription-metadata
```

## `@jpisgeek/subscription-metadata`

### Arguments

| argument                           | type                                                                      | required | default | description                                          |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `provider`                         | string                                                                    | yes      |         | Subscription provider or product family              |
| `planName`                         | string                                                                    | no       |         |                                                      |
| `billingCadence`                   | `monthly` \| `annual` \| `quarterly` \| `weekly` \| `one-time` \| `other` | no       |         |                                                      |
| `priceMinor`                       | string                                                                    | no       |         | Declared recurring price in currency minor units     |
| `currency`                         | string                                                                    | no       |         |                                                      |
| `renewalStart`                     | string                                                                    | no       |         |                                                      |
| `renewalEnd`                       | string                                                                    | no       |         |                                                      |
| `seats`                            | integer                                                                   | no       |         | Declared seat count; explicit zero is preserved      |
| `declaredLimits`                   | array of object                                                           | no       | `[]`    |                                                      |
| `declaredLimits[].name`            | string                                                                    | yes      |         | Provider-declared limit name                         |
| `declaredLimits[].value`           | number                                                                    | yes      |         | Declared numeric limit; explicit zero is preserved   |
| `declaredLimits[].unit`            | string                                                                    | yes      |         | Provider-declared unit                               |
| `declaredLimits[].period`          | string                                                                    | no       |         | Optional reset or measurement period                 |
| `declaredLimits[].sourceReference` | string                                                                    | no       |         | Optional authorized stable API or operator reference |
| `sourceReference`                  | string                                                                    | no       |         | Optional authorized stable API or operator reference |

### Methods

#### `capture`

Persist the configured plan facts exactly as declared without network access or
derived values.

No arguments.

### Data written

| resource   | lifetime | fields                                                                                                                                                       | description                                                                                      |
| ---------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `snapshot` | 365d     | `provider`, `planName`, `billingCadence`, `priceMinor`, `currency`, `renewalStart`, `renewalEnd`, `seats`, `declaredLimits`, `sourceReference`, `provenance` | Explicit subscription plan metadata with operator provenance and no derived quota or usage cost. |

## Example

```yaml
globalArguments:
  provider: Example AI
  planName: Team
  billingCadence: monthly
  priceMinor: "2500"
  currency: USD
  seats: 4
  declaredLimits:
    - name: Included requests
      value: 1000
      unit: requests
      period: month
reports:
  require:
    - "@jpisgeek/subscription-metadata"
```

## Caveats

Values are declarations, not live billing facts, unless the operator cites an
authorized stable API in sourceReference. Missing fields remain absent.
priceMinor is the recurring plan price in currency minor units and never API
usage cost. Limits whose name, unit, or period declares remaining quota,
availability, or per-token price are rejected, and that check folds zero-width
characters and homoglyphs first. Currency uses three uppercase letters; price
and currency must be supplied together; priceMinor carries at most fifteen
integer digits and four decimals, so it survives the report's numeric conversion
without loss; renewal timestamps use ISO datetime values; limit units use
lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen. This package performs no
account-dashboard scraping.

## Security

This package performs no network, process, environment, or vault operations.
Plan, price, renewal, and seat metadata can be commercially sensitive, so
protect stored Swamp data and rendered dashboards accordingly. Do not put
credentials, private account URLs, or bearer query parameters in
sourceReference. References must use HTTPS and cannot contain credentials, query
parameters, or fragments.

See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/jpisgeek/slog-bog/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
for the release gates every version passes before it reaches the registry.
